parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

1
analytic[ænəlitik]adj.
If something is analytic, it is related to logic and reasoning.
→ The analytic article criticized the new plan and presented one of its own.
2
assert[əsə:rt]v.
To assert a fact or belief means to state it with confidence.
→ He asserted that his mother’s cooking was better than his best friend’s.
3
bachelor[bætʃələr]n.
A bachelor is an unmarried man.
→ Since he was a bachelor, Jason did his shopping by himself.
4
calculus[kælkjələs]n.
Calculus is an advanced type of mathematics.
→ By using calculus, scientists determined small changes in the stars’ brightness.
5
celestial[səlestʃəl]adj.
If something is celestial, it is related to the sky or to outer space.
→ Comets are celestial objects that are rarely seen.
6
cognitive[kɑgnətiv]adj.
If something is cognitive, it is related to learning and knowing things.
→ After her physical examination, her cognitive strengths were tested.
7
collision[kəliʒən]n.
A collision is the act of two things hitting into each another.
→ The collision between the two cars created a loud noise.
8
competent[kɑmpətənt]adj.
If someone is competent, they are able to think or act successfully.
→ Competent employees are much better than unknowledgeable ones.
9
diploma[diploumə]n.
A diploma is a certificate proving that someone has completed their studies.
→ After four years of college, Mary finally had a diploma.
10
excel[iksel]v.
To excel at a subject or activity means to be very good at it.
→ Jenny excels at playing the piano.
11
geology[dʒi:ɑlədʒi]n.
Geology is the study of the Earth’s natural structures and how they change.
→ Because he studied geology, he knew how the mountains were formed.
12
harness[hɑ:rnis]v.
To harness something means to control and use it, usually to make energy.
→ The sails harness the wind in order to move.
13
intellect[intəlekt]n.
An intellect is a person’s ability to understand things easily.
→ She was known for her quick and strong intellect as well as her beauty.
14
keen[ki:n]adj.
If someone is keen, they are intelligent.
→ Only the keenest of students could have solved that math problem.
15
mythology[miθɑlədʒi]n.
Mythology is a group of stories from a particular country or region.
→ Egyptian mythology was the basis for a religion.
16
physiology[fiziɑlədʒi]n.
Physiology is the study of the various parts of living things.
→ His work in physiology helped him understand how the human body works.
17
radioactive[reidiouæktiv]adj.
If something is radioactive, then it lets out, or is related to, radiation.
→ Radioactive materials can be very bad for anyone’s health.
18
relativity[relətivəti]n.
Relativity is a set of ideas about time and space developed by Albert Einstein.
→ Relativity teaches that light travels at the same speed in the universe.
19
sociology[sousiɑlədʒi]n.
Sociology is the study of human society, its organizations, and problems.
→ Sociology teaches that people’s problems are a result of their society.
20
theoretical[θi:əretikəl]adj.
If something is theoretical, it is based on theory rather than experience.
→ His conclusion was only theoretical and not meant to be publicized.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: 1. What is geology the study of?
questions.explanation: geology (địa chất học) nghiên cứu cấu trúc của Trái Đất.

questions.content: 2. In physiology, you would probably study something like______ .
questions.explanation: physiology (sinh lý học) nghiên cứu về các bộ phận của sinh vật sống.

questions.content: 3. Which of the following would NOT be considered celestial?
questions.explanation: celestial liên quan đến thiên thể, bầu trời. Điều hướng (Navigation) không phải là thiên thể.

questions.content: 4. What else does sociology deal with besides people and their culture?
questions.explanation: sociology (xã hội học) nghiên cứu các vấn đề của con người.

questions.content: 5. If you excel at something, then that means you are______ .
questions.explanation: excel là xuất sắc. Xuất sắc nghĩa là giỏi về điều gì đó.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the one that is similar in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: 1. intellect
questions.explanation: intellect (trí tuệ) tương đương với ability (khả năng).

questions.content: 2. calculus
questions.explanation: calculus (giải tích) tương đương với math (toán học).

questions.content: 3. assert
questions.explanation: assert (khẳng định) tương đương với state (tuyên bố).

questions.content: 4. cognitive
questions.explanation: cognitive (nhận thức) tương quan với learning (học tập).

questions.content: 5. diploma
questions.explanation: diploma (chứng chỉ) tương đương với license (giấy phép).

questions.content: 6. mythology
questions.explanation: mythology (thần thoại) tương đương với folklore (văn học dân gian).

questions.content: 7. analytic
questions.explanation: analytic (phân tích) tương đương với logical (hợp lý, logic).

questions.content: 8. harness
questions.explanation: harness (khai thác) tương đương với use (sử dụng).

questions.content: 9. competent
questions.explanation: competent (có năng lực) tương đương với capable (có khả năng).

questions.content: 10. collision
questions.explanation: collision (sự va chạm) tương đương với crash.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: 1. In physiology, we studied various types of rock and the process that made them.
questions.explanation: physiology (sinh lý học) không nghiên cứu về các loại đá. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: 2. She feared that if no one married her, she’d be a bachelor her entire life.
questions.explanation: bachelor chỉ người đàn ông độc thân, không dùng cho phụ nữ. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: 3. Many old factories harnessed rivers and streams to power their equipment.
questions.explanation: harness (khai thác, sử dụng). Khai thác sông suối để làm năng lượng là đúng.

questions.content: 4. Her knowledge of different societies came from her work in sociology.
questions.explanation: sociology (xã hội học) nghiên cứu về các xã hội khác nhau là đúng.

questions.content: 5. If the two bikes hadn’t turned at the last moment, there would have been a collision.
questions.explanation: collision (sự va chạm). Nếu không rẽ kịp sẽ có va chạm là đúng.

questions.content: 6. In geology, we learned about the importance of our bones.
questions.explanation: geology (địa chất học) nghiên cứu về đá, không phải về xương. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: 7. The only proof that the new rocket would work was theoretical.
questions.explanation: theoretical (trên lý thuyết). Bằng chứng duy nhất chỉ nằm trên lý thuyết là đúng.

questions.content: 8. The car excelled every time he stepped on the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: excel (xuất sắc) không dùng để miêu tả xe ô tô tăng tốc. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: 9. Learning about calculus in my literature class was a really enjoyable time.
questions.explanation: calculus (giải tích) không thể được học trong lớp văn học (literature). Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: 10. The test proved that Mark was keener than his older brother Dave.
questions.explanation: keen (thông minh, sắc sảo). Bài kiểm tra chứng minh Mark thông minh hơn là đúng.

sections.title: Exercise 4: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: 1. She really learned a lot from just one class of the beliefs and stories of different cultures.
questions.explanation: beliefs and stories of different cultures tương đương với mythology.

questions.content: 2. When he states the fact with confidence that flowers can grow here, you believe him.
questions.explanation: states the fact with confidence tương đương với asserts.

questions.content: 3. The tests will prove whether or not his discovery is real and not just based on theory.
questions.explanation: based on theory tương đương với theoretical.

questions.content: 4. The dangerous thing about nuclear power is the radiation waste it produces.
questions.explanation: radiation tương đương với radioactive.

questions.content: 5. John has good learning skills that have helped him in his studies.
questions.explanation: learning skills tương quan với cognitive.

questions.content: 6. The stars and moon in outer space objects lit the path so I could see where I was walking.
questions.explanation: outer space objects tương đương với celestial.

questions.content: 7. Having a certificate of completed studies will give him more options for the future.
questions.explanation: certificate of completed studies tương đương với diploma.

questions.content: 8. Albert Einstein’s ideas about time and space changed both science and the world.
questions.explanation: ideas about time and space của Einstein gọi là relativity.

questions.content: 9. You have to be very intelligent in order to solve this puzzle in a short amount of time.
questions.explanation: intelligent tương đương với keen.

questions.content: 10. Every day the unmarried men came to her home to see which of them she might choose.
questions.explanation: unmarried men tương đương với bachelors.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Bachelor’s Lesson

A keen young bachelor had finished his studies at the university. As soon as he had received his diploma, he asserted to everyone he met that he was the smartest person in town.

“I excel at everything I study,” he said, bragging about his knowledge. “I’ve mastered calculus and physiology. I even understand the great theoretical teachings of science, such as relativity. There is nothing that I don’t know. Whether it’s the movements of celestial objects, like planets and stars, or how to harness the power of radioactive substances, I know everything.”

But actually, there was something the bachelor did not know. Though his analytic abilities were great, he failed to notice he was missing something very important in his life.

One day while walking through town, the bachelor witnessed a collision between two cars. Both drivers appeared to be injured, but the scholar only stood and watched.

He thought to himself, “Those idiots should have been more alert. They really must not be very competent.” He never thought the drivers needed help.

“Please help me,” said the female driver in a weak voice. “Help me, too,” said the male driver. “I’m hurt and can’t move.”

Suddenly the bachelor realized he was the only person near the accident. He quit thinking and ran to help the drivers. He carefully helped them out of their vehicles and then called an ambulance.

The drivers were saved, and the bachelor felt the best he had in his entire life. Studying mythology, sociology, and geology didn’t give him this wonderful feeling. It was the act of helping others, not his cognitive skills, that gave him this great feeling.

He had learned an important lesson. He learned that intellect isn’t everything; being helpful is just as important. “Having only a brain is not enough,” he thought. “You must also have a heart.”

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement True (T) or False (F).

questions.content: 1. The bachelor excelled at calculus, physiology, and theoretical science, such as relativity.
questions.explanation: Đúng với câu chuyện: 'I excel at everything... I’ve mastered calculus and physiology. I even understand the great theoretical teachings... relativity.'

questions.content: 2. He knew the movements of radioactive materials and how to harness the power of celestial objects.
questions.explanation: Sai. Anh ta biết về 'movements of celestial objects' và 'harness the power of radioactive substances', câu hỏi đã đổi ngược hai khái niệm này.

questions.content: 3. The bachelor thought the drivers in the collision were not competent.
questions.explanation: Đúng với câu chuyện: 'They really must not be very competent.'

questions.content: 4. Studying mythology, sociology, and geology gave the bachelor a wonderful feeling.
questions.explanation: Sai. Việc giúp đỡ người khác mới mang lại cảm giác tuyệt vời, không phải việc học.

questions.content: 5. The bachelor’s intellect and not his cognitive talents had made him feel this great.
questions.explanation: Sai. Chính hành động giúp đỡ người khác (the act of helping others), chứ không phải tài năng nhận thức (cognitive talents), đã làm anh cảm thấy như vậy.

questions.content: 1. What did the keen bachelor assert after receiving his diploma?
options: He asserted to everyone he met that he was the smartest person in town.
He asserted he wanted to travel the world.
He asserted he would become a doctor.
He asserted he wanted to get married.
questions.explanation: As soon as he had received his diploma, he asserted to everyone he met that he was the smartest person in town.

questions.content: 2. What happened while the bachelor was strolling through town?
options: He witnessed a collision between two cars.
He found a lot of money.
questions.explanation: One day while strolling through the town, the bachelor witnessed a collision between two cars.

questions.content: 3. How did the bachelor feel after saving the drivers?
options: He felt the best he had in his entire life.
He felt very tired and hungry.
He felt like he wasted his time.
questions.explanation: The bachelor felt the best he had in his entire life.

questions.content: 4. Despite his analytic abilities, what did the bachelor fail to notice about his life?
options: He failed to notice he was missing something very important in his life.
He failed to notice his clothes were dirty.
He failed to notice the beautiful weather.
He failed to notice his family.
questions.explanation: Despite his analytic abilities, he failed to notice he was missing something very important in his life.

questions.content: 5. Besides a brain, what did the bachelor realize was important to have in life?
options: He realized that you must also have a heart.
He realized he needed a lot of money.
He realized he needed to read more books.
He realized he must have a car.
questions.explanation: Besides a brain, the bachelor realized that you must also have a heart.
